'''''Les Aventuriers de Koh-Lanta''''' is the first season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''. This season aired on TF1 on Saturdays and Sundays at 6:55 p.m from August 4 to September 22, 2001.

[[Gilles Nicolet]] defeated [[Guénaëlle Biras]] in a 4-3 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]]. To date, this season has produced three returning players (Guénaëlle Biras, [[Jean-Luc Fiorina]] and [[Sandra Acabado]]) for future seasons.
==Production==
With the resounding success of {{S|1}}, the French television network TF1 decided to make its own version of ''[[Survivor (franchise)|Survivor]]''. 

Approximately 16,000 applications were sent. One hundred of them then got interviewed, took physical tests, and were given a thorough medical examination. Sixteen people got selected to participate.

This season was hosted by {{wp|Hubert Auriol}}. Filming took place in 2001 on the coast of {{wp|Ko Lanta District|Ko Lanta}} in {{wp|Thailand}} and lasted 43 days. The prize for the winner was €100,000, equivalent to roughly US$109,000 in 2023.
==Format==
* '''[[Tribe]] Composition:''' The sixteen castaways were divided into two tribes of eight.
* '''[[Merge]]:''' The tribes merged on Day 21 with ten contestants remaining.
* '''[[Ambassadors]]:''' At the merge, each tribe sends one ambassador to a meeting. The two ambassadors must agree on one castaway who would receive an extra vote against them at the next [[Tribal Council]]. If they fail to come to a consensus, the two of them draw rocks, and the extra vote is cast against the one who loses the draw.
* '''Final Four Elimination:''' At the final four, the remaining castaways compete in the ''[[Fallen Comrades]]'' challenge, and the castaway with the fewest right answers is eliminated from the game.
